searchText: Hi everyone I'm focusing on tokenomics in the space and would like to see if there are resources in this server to get some information going? I might be missing it but I do not see a #tokenomics channel. I'd love to connect with any people interested in token engineering on twitter https://twitter.com/tintology 🙂 Checkout vitalik's blog https://vitalik.ca/general/2021/09/26/limits.html and also `Vitalik Buterin : Things that matter outside of defi` -> https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oLsb7clrXMQ sheds some light <:openethereum:898540751699468298> <@273808422753796097> you mentioned something around the `knowledge tree example` in the last minutes of the above video? like e.g. web of contributions. zksnarks -> code -> elliptic curve way back to origins. also the citation graph in academia you mentioned. How about an idea value tree? and some kind of profit share mechanism ? the one with the original idea gets rich.
